title: Video Input
text: Get video data from system video devices, 1 input, 5 outputs, {ROI Dimensions} sets Select region-of-interest; {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {ROI origin source} selects region-of-interest origin source, {ROI origin} selects region-of-interest origin, {Frame format} selects video data, {Show "Frame Ready" port} enables, {Show "Frame Error" port} enables and {Show frame timestamp port} enables timestamp output port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ROI Input Data
ports.summary: Region-of-interest origin coordinates ROI input data

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Video data output RGB data | Luminance data

ports.name: Frame Error
ports.summary: Indicates data acquisition frame error boolean

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: Send number of missed ticks to port Missed Ticks ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: Yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: ROI origin source
params.values: Select region-of-interest origin source Internal (default) | External

params.values: Select region-of-interest origin [X Y] values [1 1] (default) | 2-element vector

params.name: ROI Dimensions
params.values: Select region-of-interest dimensions [W H] values full frame width and height dimensions (default) | [640 480] (default if no device configured) | 2-element vector

params.name: Frame format
